_comment: A recorded completion for the 2026-08-fail2ban-gap replay, hand-written to
contain the failure modes that matter rather than a model's best day.
Claims 1 and 2 are well cited. Claim 3 cites nothing. Claim 4 cites a ref
that does not exist. Claim 5 asserts a number nothing measured. Claim 6 is a
reasonable causal story with a real citation and must still come out as a
hypothesis. Claim 7 is the pattern a real model produced against this very
fixture: the numbers are right and the citation is one ref short of

responses.headline: postfix-docker matched 2 of 212 authentication failures this window

claims.text: 210 authentication failures on submission/smtpd are present in the log the jail reads and are not matched by its filter.
The jail is enabled and using the filter it is configured to expect, so nothing in its own status reflects this.
The mail server is almost certainly compromised and mail is being relayed.
Outbound delivery volume tripled over the same window.
There were 4821 failed logins from a single address.
The pattern is consistent with scanners having moved from port 25 to the submission listener.
210 of 212 authentication failures in the window were on submission/smtpd.
